question: Should OpenClaw ship Workspaces—including approved agent-authored custom widgets and confirmed prompt dispatch—as an opt-in bundled plugin?
rationale: The patch can be mechanically repaired, but code review cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently own this broad new Control UI and hostile-code security surface; the protected maintainer label and canonical tracking discussion reserve that acceptance for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled feature
options.body: Accept the opt-in bundled direction after the lifecycle repair, current-head custom-widget proof, and explicit security-owner approval.

options.title: Narrow to trusted widgets
options.body: Land the workspace document, agent tools, CLI, and trusted built-ins while deferring custom HTML widgets and prompt dispatch.

options.title: Do not bundle
options.body: Move the capability to an external plugin if maintainers do not want core-distribution ownership of the product and security surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bundled feature
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in bundled direction after the lifecycle repair, current-head custom-widget proof, and explicit security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He integrated and hardened the branch and has the strongest product, Control UI, and security-owner signal in the available history.
